title: Interview Exchange Record
description: One exchange of an interview session: the interviewer's words, the interviewee's words as dictated, and the interviewer's reading, kept apart. Written only through a stamping writer: exchange, session and ts are set by the writer from the file and the clock, never by the author. One session is one JSONL file; the session id is the first record's timestamp in basic ISO form, and a citation is session:exchange.

exchange.description: Stamped: position in the session file, counted from 1. Never supplied by the author.

session.description: Stamped: the session id, the first record's timestamp as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ. Minted on the first record, copied to every later one. Never supplied by the author.

ts.description: Stamped: time of writing, ISO 8601 Zulu. Never supplied by the author.

agent.description: What the interviewer said or asked (may be empty for interviewee-initiated exchanges).

stt.description: The interviewee's words as dictated, filler removed, an STT error corrected only at high certainty. Ground truth, immutable. Non-verbatim exchanges use bare markers: '{TRANSFERRED}' for written conversation incorporated into the interview, '{RECONSTRUCTED}' for content reconstructed after the original was lost.

user.description: Cleaned transcript, derived from stt. Non-verbatim exchanges are bracketed: '{TRANSFERRED}...{/TRANSFERRED}' (reliable, but denser than speech), '{RECONSTRUCTED}...{/RECONSTRUCTED}' (carries reification risk). Processing agents use these brackets to calibrate trust.

llm_log.description: The interviewer's real-time reading: what it understood, what it planned to ask, what it flagged. Interpretation, never quotable as the interviewee's words.

learned.description: What the interviewer understood from this exchange.

threads.description: Follow-up directions the interviewer planned to explore.

insight.description: A flagged interesting moment, if any.

correction.description: What an earlier reading got wrong. Corrections are appended as new exchanges, never edited into old ones.

archive.description: Base64-encoded previous version, LLM-opaque audit trail.
